messages.body:
T-5 (AC-10, preserve): Proven on branch crew/2026-10-15-001/T-5, commit 2aae5b5.

Proven:
- The new describe in tests/integration/rejudge.test.ts drives the real TypeSafeJudge through a stand-in fetch. It checks four things: the three question keys, their exact version 1 instructions, no reader in the state, and judge_version '1' on every judged row.
- crew tdd before passed (10 pass). crew tdd after passed (10 pass).
- What changed: DistillInput.wording?: 1 | 2 in src/judge/types.ts. In src/judge/rejudge.ts: IMPORT_WORDING = 1 and IMPORT_JUDGE_VERSION = String(IMPORT_WORDING), asInput typed DistillInput and sending wording: IMPORT_WORDING, and the stamp taken from IMPORT_JUDGE_VERSION. The TypeSafe capability check stays.
- Gates: secrets, prose, build, test (bun run test), lint and typecheck pass. The code-quality and test-quality judgement gates are proven with 5 advisory findings: unused exports; wording written but not read until Task 6; the check that no longer uses its value; a mutant that removes wording survives until Task 6; question literals copied from questions.ts.

Not proven:
- That the test protects anything once the questions move. Nothing reads wording yet, so this criterion only guards something after Task 6. Task 6 must record crew tdd after AC-10 again.
- The criterion is AC-1 on this child item (AC-10 on the parent).

Touched only src/judge/types.ts, src/judge/rejudge.ts and tests/integration/rejudge.test.ts. The worktree had no node_modules, so I ran bun install --frozen-lockfile. Nothing was merged or pushed.

messages.subject: Re: T-4 of 2026-10-15-001-memory-quality-knowledge-not-records-of
messages.body:
T-4 (AC-5) proven on branch crew/2026-10-15-001/T-4, commit 1f0a40a. The commit changes src/judge/heuristic.ts, tests/unit/heuristic-judge.test.ts and tests/unit/typesafe-judge.test.ts:412, as Task 4 of the plan says.

What the code does: a sentence with a report signal (commit hash, PR/MR reference, status verb in English or Portuguese, verdict word, test count) loses REPORT_PENALTY 0.25, with the 0.05 floor kept. An answer where at least REPORT_SHARE 0.6 of the final sentences carry a signal loses REPORT_DISCOUNT 0.2 of its worth. heuristicJudge is version 2. heuristicJudgeV1 (version 1, signals off) is exported and nothing in the drain uses it. The fallback test now expects { typesafe: "1", heuristic: "2" }.

What is proven:
- The test-first run is recorded: red (heuristicJudgeV1 missing), then green, 62/62 in heuristic-judge.test.ts.
- These gates pass: secrets, prose, build, test, lint and typecheck. The test gate is the full suite: 1978 pass, 0 fail, including tests/golden/judges.test.ts and filter.test.ts.
- The code-quality and test-quality judgement gates are proven by the judge.
- lead-qa and lead-security validated the spec and the delivery.
- tests/golden/typesafe-answers.json is untouched.

What is not proven:
- No mutation run was done.
- The advisory findings are left open:
  1. Two missing tests: an under/over-60% contrast for the worth discount (the existing test at line 398 does fail without the discount, per the judge), and the REPORT_SHARE boundary and its finals.length>0 guard.
  2. No test of its own for the /pull/<n> URL form or for STATUS_VERB alone.
  3. heuristicJudgeV1 has no caller outside the tests until the proof script (Task 7) lands.
  4. The report-share computation could become a named helper.
- This worktree needed bun install (no node_modules).

messages.body: T-6 is not proven. Commit 6160331 on crew/2026-10-15-001/T-6. Proven: AC-2 of the child item (the golden input goes through prepareTexts; host blocks and dropped sentences never reach the judge), with red and green recorded. That green run also covers tests/unit/questions.test.ts (version 2 questions; version 1 reduced to worth, kind and importance), typesafe-judge, judge-select, rejudge (the AC-10 test still passes with the TypeSafe version at 2) and tests/golden/filter.test.ts (the heuristic's floors over the 40 turns). Not proven: AC-1 (the lead's AC-4). TypeSafe's answers were not re-recorded: this session runs in dontAsk mode and refused 'bun scripts/record-typesafe.ts', a paid call with the author's key. tests/golden/typesafe-answers.json therefore still holds the version 1 answers for 32 turns, so tests/golden/judges.test.ts fails: the coverage test misses the 8 new turns, and the knowledge_<i> answers are absent. D-5 (the token ratio) is not measured; the version 1 file stays at HEAD~1. Still to do: the author runs the recording with the key, then crew tdd green AC-1 on questions, judges and filter, the D-5 script, bun run format, crew tdd after AC-10 on the parent, and the gates. The gates have not run on this item.
